description: This file declares interfaces and classes for managing process containers within the WPEFramework. It includes abstractions for network interfaces, memory, CPU processing information, and container management operations such as start, stop, and retrieval of container details.

classes.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
classes.description: Interface for iterating network interfaces with methods to retrieve interface name, number of IP addresses, and specific address.

classes.name: IMemoryInfo
classes.description: Interface providing memory usage statistics such as allocated, resident, and shared memory.

classes.name: IProcessorInfo
classes.description: Interface providing CPU processing information including total and per-core usage.

classes.name: IContainerIterator
classes.description: Iterator interface to list container IDs.

classes.name: IContainer
classes.description: Represents a process container with methods to retrieve its ID, PID, memory, CPU info, network interfaces, and control start/stop operations.

methods.name: Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a container instance by ID, searching specified paths, with log path and configuration.

methods.name: Logging
methods.description: Enables logging for the container framework with specified log path and options.

methods.name: Containers
methods.description: Returns an iterator over all created containers.

methods.name: Get
methods.description: Retrieves a container by its ID, or nullptr if not found.

ctags.name: IContainerIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class IContainerIterator : public Core::IIterator, public Core::IReferenceCounted {$/

ctags.name: INetworkInterfaceIterator
ctags.pattern: /^    class INetworkInterfaceIterator : public Core::IIterator,  public Core::IReferenceCounted  {$/
